target: Minimal squared coefficient of variation of ME(3): prove that every order-3 matrix-exponential law has SCV >= v_cos (so the minimum over ME(3) equals v_cos, attained by the cosine family), or give an explicit ME(3) law with certified nonnegative density and certified SCV < v_cos.

book_link.scope: Thematic bridge only: the minimal-SCV ME(3) conjecture is a precise published open conjecture in the same representation-order theory, not the book's own question. No book question is claimed solved.

exact_statement.class: ME(3) per Horváth–Sáfár–Telek–Zámbó 2016 Definitions 1–2: X nonnegative continuous with F(t)=Pr(X<t)=1-alpha*exp(A t)*1, alpha real 1×n, A real n×n, n<=3 (order at most 3); density f(t)=-alpha*A*exp(A t)*1 >= 0 on [0,inf). Equivalently a probability law on [0,inf) without atom whose Laplace–Stieltjes transform is rational with denominator degree <= 3. No sign structure on alpha or A.
exact_statement.objective: SCV(X)=m0*m2/m1^2-1 with m_k=integral t^k f(t) dt (HSTZ Definition5 'cv').
exact_statement.constant: v_cos := min over omega>0, phi real of SCV(e^{-t}(1-cos(omega t - phi))). Parent numerical aid (not a premise): about 0.2009015635005570 at (omega,phi) about (1.0359329551, 0.3370382424); 1/v about 4.977562059. The literal decimal 0.200902 is a rounded value and must not be used as the bound.
exact_statement.positive: A written proof that SCV(X) >= v_cos for EVERY X in ME(3): all pole configurations (three distinct real; repeated real; one real plus complex pair with equal damping; one real plus complex pair with strictly faster complex damping; and lower-order degenerations), with any certified computation fully specified, independently re-runnable and with all unbounded parameter tails covered by written lemmas.
exact_statement.negative: An explicit ME(3) representation with exact or certified-interval proof that f(t)>=0 for ALL t>=0 (including the tail and every touching point) and certified SCV < v_cos (with v_cos bounded below rigorously).

primary.conjecture: HSTZ 2016, EPEW LNCS 9951:18–31, https://math.bme.hu/~safaro/cikkek/osafarepew.pdf abstract: 'for the first non-trivial order, which is order 3, the cv cannot be less than 0.200902 but the proof of this conjecture is still missing'; Section2: 'No analytic results are available for the minimal value of cv in the class ME(n) for any n >= 3.' Parent read 2026-10-18.

initial_representation: UNTRUSTED parent hint (a proof route, not a target restriction). (1) For fixed poles the nonnegative densities form a closed pointed 3-dim cone; SCV/(1+SCV)=min over theta of a ratio of linear functionals, so the minimum over a cone is attained on extreme rays. (2) Real poles: double-zero extreme rays are Hermite–Genocchi mixtures of e^{-mu t}(t-tau)^2; boundary rays are lower order. (3) Equal damping: extreme rays are exactly e^{-t}(1-cos(omega t - phi)), i.e. v_cos by definition. (4) Real pole 1, complex pair -(1+delta)±i omega, delta>0: extreme rays f=e^{-t}h, h(t)=1-e^{-delta(t-tau)}(cos(omega(t-tau))+(delta/omega) sin(omega(t-tau))), tau in [0,tau1(delta,omega)] with feasibility equivalent to h(0)>=0 for tau<2pi/omega; closed-form moments m_k=k!-e^{delta tau} Re[(1-i delta/omega) e^{-i omega tau} k!/(1+delta-i omega)^{k+1}]. A certified bound over (delta,omega,tau) needs written tail lemmas and a local lemma at delta->0 near the cosine optimum. Every step must be proved or re-derived by the worker; the parent hint has no evidential weight.
first_obligation: Freeze the lane README before substantive experiments. Re-read HSTZ Definitions1–5/eq.(4)/Table2 and fix the convention against the parent pin. Write and prove the reduction lemmas (dominant real pole; extreme rays; real-pole bound; equal-damping family). Then specify the certified non-common-damping computation (domain, compactification, tails, local lemma, arithmetic library and rounding mode) BEFORE running it. A complex-dominant or equal-damping-only result is partial.
controls: Erlang-3 gives 1/3; the real-pole kernel minimum reproduces about 0.276583; the cos family minimum reproduces v_cos to >=12 digits; the literal HSTZ eq.(4)/Table2 reading (about 1.5757) is rejected as a convention error; a deliberately infeasible double-zero ray (tau>tau1) is detected as negative somewhere; mutated certificate boxes/bounds fail for the intended reason; tail-lemma constants are checked at sample points.
